visual_identity.core_identity: An amorphous crawling aberration formed from a lumpy mass of fleshlike material covered in many unrelated eyes and mouths.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low spreading irregular mound with several protruding mouths and eyes distributed across its surface, no stable limbs.
visual_identity.head_features: No single head; multiple mouths of different sizes and several eyes are scattered across the mass.
visual_identity.body_shape: Soft shapeless crawling mound with pseudopod-like lower edges, never resolving into humanoid anatomy.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth folds with sparse bumps; mouths and eyes provide identity without dense gore.
must_avoid: too many tiny mouths causing clutter

accuracy_checks: eyes are scattered rather than forming one face
body-ground contact and crawling motion read without fixed limbs

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
